title: Text marketing for finance | SMS finance and tax | SimpleTexting

facts.fact: The average email open rate dropped to 21.3% in 2020, a decrease compared to 2019, according to SuperOffice as cited by the page.
facts.quote: In 2020, the average open rate for an email [dropped to 21.3%](https://www.superoffice.com/blog/email-open-rates/) (a decrease compared to 2019).

facts.fact: In 2019, Americans answered less than half of all calls they received on their cell phones, per a BusinessWire report cited by the page.
facts.quote: In 2019, Americans [answered half of all calls](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20190625006028/en/Americans-Now-Answer-Less-Than-Half-of-All-Calls-They-Receive-on-their-Mobile-Phones) they received on their cell phones.

facts.fact: The page states that 90% of all texts are read within three minutes.
facts.quote: [90% of all texts](https://simpletexting.com/guide/sms-marketing/) are read in three minutes

facts.fact: A simple SMS generates a response rate 5x that of email, according to a third-party CallHub statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: a simple SMS generates a response rate [5x that of email.](https://callhub.io/text-message-statistics/#:~:text=Text%20messages%20have%20a%2045,can%20be%20a%20big%20task.)

facts.fact: Almost two-thirds of customers would switch to a company that offered text messaging as a communication channel, per a PRNewswire study cited by the page.
facts.quote: almost [two-thirds of customers](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/study-shows-us-customers-prefer-texting-with-businesses-300974034.html) would switch to a company that offered text messaging as a communication channel.

facts.fact: An example keyword opt-in confirmation message states that msg and data rates may apply and that the subscriber will receive 4 messages per month.
facts.quote: Msg&Data rates may apply. 4msg/month. Reply STOP to cancel.

facts.fact: Promotional texts require the contact's consent; the page states that with consent to text promotional messages, contacts can be imported from a spreadsheet and campaigns sent.
facts.quote: As long as you have [consent to text](https://simpletexting.com/in-depth-guide/sms-compliance-guide/understanding-express-written-consent/) promotional messages, you can start sending campaigns.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers a 14-day free trial for its SMS marketing platform.
facts.quote: sign up for a 14-day free trial

facts.fact: The page provides eight text message templates for inspiration, covering appointment reminders, tax reminders, and suspicious banking activity alerts.
facts.quote: here are eight texts you can use for inspiration

facts.fact: SimpleTexting promotes an on-demand webinar titled '3 SMS Campaigns to Get Through the Tax Season' that is tied to the 2023 tax season by its URL.
facts.quote: 3 SMS Campaigns to Get Through the Tax Season
